summary: Morpheus gathers everyone on the main deck and introduces Neo to the crew he does not know — Mouse, Cypher, Switch, Tank, and Dozer — while Trinity smiles and nods. He identifies the room as the Core, the place where they broadcast their pirate signal and hack into the Matrix, surrounded by a swamp of electronic equipment. Morpheus tells Neo that the answer to what the Matrix is lies within him, touching the back of his head, then has Trinity help Neo into one of six ecto-skeleton chairs. Morpheus guides a coaxial cable into the port on the back of Neo's neck, warning it will feel weird. As he works the needle in, his shoulders hunch and his face contorts into a grimace until a sharp CLICK echoes and his ears pop., after which he relaxes and opens his eyes to a feeling of weightlessness in another place.

what_changes.after: He is being taken to the source of the answer, told 'The answer is right here,' and is about to experience the Matrix directly.

what_changes.before: Standing, anxious, being guided into the chair.

what_changes.before: Unfamiliar with the crew and wary of the procedure.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus introduces Neo to the crew and the Core, then jacks him into the Matrix to show him what it is.

_mind_pass: ran: 1 speaker, 270w >= p75 (125w) for this work

minds.wants: To finally get the answer to 'what is the Matrix' after being told repeatedly that answers are coming.
minds.feels: Overwhelmed and disoriented. The names and faces are meaningless noise because his mind is still catching up to the revelation that it's ~2197. There's a deep, wordless anxiety about the physical modifications to his body (discovered in sc-037) now being put to use.
minds.shows: Passive compliance — 'allows himself to be helped [.] endures the disturbing needle-in-neck sensation, shoulders bunching, face tightening into a grimace, but does not pull away or object.
minds.basis: Neo watches the faces and names blur without meaning.' He allows himself to be helped. His body's involuntary reaction (shoulders bunch, grimace) during the jacking contrasts with his ultimate stillness/acceptance.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is a guide who will finally explain things rather than just promise explanations.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus's method is experiential, not verbal — he is about to be *shown*, not told, which Neo cannot yet anticipate; and Morpheus is steering him toward something far more destabilizing than a definition (the history of the war, ev-009).

minds.wants: To bring Neo to the threshold of direct experience — to stop promising answers and begin delivering them, transitioning from 'the answers are coming' (sc-036) to 'the answer is right here.'
minds.feels: A quiet, controlled confidence and ceremonial gravity. He is performing an initiation he has done before, treating the jacking as routine while aware it is Neo's first and frightening contact.
minds.shows: Calm, didactic authority — a tour-guide cadence ('This is the main deck... That's Mouse, Cypher, and Switch... this is the Core'), culminating in the deliberate, almost mystical gesture of touching the back of Neo's head and the reassuring 'This will feel a little weird.'
minds.basis: He introduces the crew and Core with explanatory clarity, then redirects Neo's intellectual question ('what is the Matrix?') to a physical locus by touching the jack. He normalizes the invasive procedure with understatement.

believes_about.belief: That Neo is ready — that his mind can take the next step of direct exposure to the Matrix.
believes_about.wrong_because: Neo is about to reject the revelation (ev-009); Morpheus's confidence in Neo's readiness is, in this moment, more faith than confirmed fact.

minds.wants: To support Morpheus's initiation smoothly and be present for Neo without disrupting the ceremony.
minds.feels: A watchful, already-formed investment in Neo that exceeds the casual friendliness she displays — the residue of her role in his awakening and her stake in what Morpheus believes Neo to be.
minds.shows: A smile and a nod at her introduction; then silent, competent assistance when Morpheus says 'Help him.' She offers no commentary.
minds.basis: 'Trinity smiles and nods' on introduction. Morpheus singles her out to physically help Neo into the chair, and she complies without hesitation.

believes_about.belief: That he is the one Morpheus has been waiting for — the potential 'One.'
believes_about.wrong_because: Unverifiable at this point; Neo is still a frightened, uncomprehending newcomer who has not yet done anything to justify the belief, and he is about to reject the whole path (ev-009).

minds.wants: To remain unremarkable — to be introduced and pass over without drawing attention or scrutiny.
minds.feels: A low, contained resentment at being paraded as part of the crew for the newest arrival; the irritation of a man already quietly at odds with this life being asked to smile at another recruit.
minds.shows: Nothing legible here — he is named in a list and given no reaction in the text, so any inner life is extrapolation from his later-established character rather than something this scene supplies.
minds.basis: He is listed among 'the ones you don't know' with no action or dialogue of his own in this scene.

minds.wants: To be acknowledged as an individual presence, not just a name in Morpheus's roll call.
minds.feels: The eager, slightly restless energy of the youngest crewman, curious about the new 'potential' being brought aboard.
minds.shows: Nothing observable in this scene — he is named only, given no reaction, so this is extrapolated.
minds.basis: Named in Morpheus's introduction with no accompanying action; his later interruption of dinner to rally the crew (ev-014) suggests an excitable temperament, but that is not on the page here.

minds.wants: To be at his station, ready to run the connection he will be responsible for.
minds.feels: A grounded, professional readiness — he is the operator who will manage Neo's jacking, and this is the first of many such sessions.
minds.shows: Nothing legible here — he is named ('those two guys are Tank and Dozer') but given no action or reaction in the text.
minds.basis: Named as part of the crew; his operator role is established in ev-011, but nothing in this scene shows him at his station or reacting.

connects_back: Neo's repeated promise that 'the answers are coming' (sc-036) and 'I can simply show it' (sc-037) now resolves into 'the answer is right here' — the deferred explanation finally arriving.
Neo's private discovery of the grafted ports in sc-037 (the forearm jack, the outlet at the base of his skull) pays off physically as the coaxial line is fed into that exact jack.
The 'cerebrum chip' in the cable recalls the chip seen inside the plant, linking the ship's tech to the earlier demonstration of the constructed nature of the world.
The ladder climb to the main deck at the end of sc-038 deposits Neo and Morpheus directly into this gathering.
sets_up: ev-009: Neo, now jacked in and immersed, will be shown the history of the machines and will reject the overwhelming truth.
ev-011: Tank's role as Neo's operator is motivated — this is the connection Tank will manage from his station.
ev-012: The jacking procedure established here is the same mechanism by which combat programs will later be downloaded directly into Neo.
dramatic_function: This is the threshold/ritual scene that converts Neo (and the audience) from being *told* about the Matrix to being *plugged into* it — the ceremonial handoff from exposition to direct experience, and the moment the ship's abstract 'pirate' mission becomes a concrete, physical act.
